title: Cheerful 3-bedroom Farmhouse, 3 miles to down town
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. Newly remodeled 1932 cottage with brand new appliances. Quick Uber ride to Broadway. Open kitchen and living area great for groups and socializing. Cottage has everything you need, 3 bedrooms 2 full baths! Every room has a queen size bed and one of the queens has a trundle pull out bed to sleep an additional person. Washer and dryer on-site and complimentary WiFi. Free parking on site for 3-4 cars or street parking is available as well.

The space
2nd bedroom is a queen size bed with a twin trundle that pulls out from underneath.

Guest access
Door codes are on both front and back door. Either one can be accessed. Parking available next to back door.
